name: IHSAA Cross Country Regionals
where: Indiana · New Prairie, Manchester, Brownsburg, Columbus (CERAland Sports Park) and Crawford County
headline: IHSAA Cross Country Regionals
summary: Final: Springs Valley's Calvin Seitz won the Crawford County regional in 14:30.7, 44.6 seconds ahead of Evansville Reitz's Carter Zieren (15:15.3). At Manchester, No. 21 Fort Wayne Carroll won the boys team title with 29 points and No. 14 Homestead won the girls with 65, and Hamilton Southeastern's Anya Zoeller won the girls race at CERAland in 17:23.4. The top five teams at each site, plus the top 15 individuals not on those teams, move on to the state finals Oct. 31 in Terre Haute.
